points.quote: The `Workbench` entity (`entities/workbench.ts`) holds the list of open views (`views$`), the active view (`activeView$`), and the right-sidebar state (`sidebarOpen$`, `sidebarWidth$`, `toggleSidebar`).
`WorkbenchRoot` (`view/workbench-root.tsx`) renders the views side by side in a `SplitView`, then `WorkbenchSidebar`. ... A `View` (`entities/view.ts`) is one pane.
It has an id, a title and icon, and its own memory `history` with a `location$`.
Each view runs its own react-router `createMemoryRouter` (`view/view-root.tsx`). `ViewRoot` watches `view.location$` and calls `viewRouter.navigate(location)`.
`view/view-islands.tsx` defines Provider/Target pairs. A route component renders `<ViewHeader>`, `<ViewBody>` and `<ViewSidebarTab>`. These are portals, and the workbench places the matching Targets.
The browser URL only reflects the active view.
`SidebarContainer` shows the active view's `ViewSidebarTab` content. Tabs are tracked in `entities/sidebar-tab.ts`.
a change in view history is pushed or replaced into the browser location, tagged `fromView,<key>`. A browser location change is pushed into the view history as `fromBrowser`.
